description: Minimal permissions for Builder Pro AI: core IPC + folder picker. The daemon is launchd-managed (spec §8.3), never shell-spawned by the app, so shell:default is retained for the tauri-plugin-shell runtime init only — no allow-execute/allow-spawn scope is granted (externalBin sidecar bundling is a tauri.conf.json build-time setting, not a runtime capability). The store/fs plugins were removed as dead code on the 2026-07-24 audit (FE-9/FE-5), so no store:*/fs:* permissions are granted.
